prompt: Follow the two levels of pointer. `pp` holds the address of `s`.

trace.label: After line 2, `*pp` is the same box as
After line 3, `s` points at the text
After line 4, `t` points at the text

explain: `*pp` follows pp to s, so `*pp = "dog"` changes s itself. `t = *pp` copies s's new value. `**pp` follows two arrows, to the first character of the text: 'd'.
